issues.desc: PLAN must define a concrete user-facing CLI transcript and delivery result: understanding_get currently returns _empty, and the checklist contains no userSees. Show that an eligible unrelated Finding remains visibly owned/routed while the current Story proceeds, an applicable mandatory-repair Finding visibly blocks with a repair path, and observe/warn/enforce status and prerequisite refusal are explicit. The updated scope requires lifecycle/verification timings; delivery must distinguish measured elapsed time from any unsupported causal optimization claim. This is an INIT advisory because understanding and verification intent are PLAN work, not evidence that product delivery is already complete.

Existing Lab implementation is baseline only. Product delivery must explicitly state the actual rollout mode and unmet prerequisites, without presenting unavailable enforce qualification as completed acceptance.
